title: Can autism be diagnosed in infancy?
metaTitle: Early Autism Diagnosis - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Autism can be diagnosed as early as infancy. At Pinnacle Blooms Network we believe in the importance of early detection and intervention in enhancing the developmental journey for children with autism.
html: Absolutely, early detection of autism is possible, and it significantly enhances the scope of improvement. While some signs of autism may become apparent within the first year itself, a detailed and more formal diagnosis can often be done when the child is around 2 to 3 years old. Early intervention, like the services offered at Pinnacle Blooms Network, allows us to address the varied developmental needs of the child effectively and timely.
